tasks.title: Complete data plane foundation with database and Redis connections
tasks.description: Implement application state initialization with PostgreSQL and Redis connections, configuration management, and shared data models
tasks.details: Create AppState struct in main.rs that holds database pools, Redis client, and configuration. Implement config.rs to load environment variables for DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, ports, and timeouts. Create models module with Route, Service, Plugin structs that match the database schema. Add connection pooling for both PostgreSQL (using sqlx) and Redis. Include graceful error handling and connection retry logic.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for configuration loading with various environment setups. Integration tests for database and Redis connectivity. Connection pool performance tests to ensure no connection leaks under load.

subtasks.title: Setup PostgreSQL database connection pool with SQLx
subtasks.description: Initialize SQLx connection pool for PostgreSQL with proper configuration and error handling
subtasks.details: Create database connection pool using sqlx::PgPool with connection configuration from DATABASE_URL environment variable. Implement connection validation, pool size limits, and connection timeout settings. Add proper error handling for connection failures and include database health check functionality.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for connection pool initialization with valid/invalid DATABASE_URL. Integration tests for database connectivity and connection pooling under load.

subtasks.title: Initialize Redis client with connection manager
subtasks.description: Setup Redis client and connection manager for caching and configuration sync
subtasks.details: Create Redis client using redis-rs with connection manager for connection pooling. Configure Redis connection from REDIS_URL environment variable with reconnection logic and timeout settings. Implement Redis health check and connection validation methods.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for Redis client initialization and connection management. Integration tests for Redis connectivity and failover scenarios.

subtasks.title: Implement configuration management and environment loading
subtasks.description: Create comprehensive configuration system for loading all environment variables and application settings
subtasks.details: Enhance config.rs to load DATABASE_URL, REDIS_URL, DATA_PLANE_PORT, timeouts, and all required environment variables. Implement Config struct with validation, default values, and proper error handling. Add configuration validation and environment-specific settings support.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for configuration loading with various environment setups and missing variables. Validation tests for required vs optional configuration parameters.

subtasks.title: Create shared data models matching database schema
subtasks.description: Implement Route, Service, Plugin, and Workspace structs that correspond to the PostgreSQL schema
subtasks.details: Create models module with structs for Route, Service, Plugin, and Workspace that match the control plane's Go models. Include proper serialization/deserialization with serde, field validation, and database mapping using sqlx attributes. Ensure workspace-based multi-tenancy support and proper relationships between entities.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for model serialization/deserialization and validation. Integration tests ensuring models correctly map to database schema and match Go counterparts.

subtasks.title: Implement error handling and connection retry logic
subtasks.description: Add comprehensive error handling with retry mechanisms and graceful degradation for database and Redis connections
subtasks.details: Create error handling framework with custom error types for database and Redis failures. Implement exponential backoff retry logic for connection failures, circuit breaker pattern for degraded services, and graceful degradation when external services are unavailable. Add logging and monitoring for connection health.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for retry logic with simulated connection failures. Integration tests for graceful degradation scenarios. Load tests ensuring system stability under connection stress.

tasks.title: Implement route matching engine with trie-based algorithm
tasks.description: Build high-performance route matching system using trie data structure for O(log n) lookup performance
tasks.details: Create routing module with RouteMatcher struct that builds trie from route configurations. Support exact paths, wildcards (*), and path parameters (:param). Implement cache layer that loads routes from Redis and falls back to PostgreSQL. Add route configuration sync mechanism to update matcher when routes change. Include priority-based matching for overlapping patterns.
tasks.testStrategy: Benchmark tests with 1000+ routes to verify O(log n) performance. Unit tests for wildcard and parameter matching. Integration tests with Redis cache updates. Load tests measuring route matching latency under concurrent requests.

subtasks.title: Design and implement trie data structure for route storage
subtasks.description: Create the core trie data structure to store route patterns with nodes representing path segments and terminal nodes storing route metadata.
subtasks.details: Implement TrieNode struct with HashMap for children and Option<RouteInfo> for terminal nodes. Create RouteInfo struct containing service_id, method, priority, and plugin configurations. Design trie insertion algorithm that splits paths by '/' and creates nodes for each segment. Include path compression optimization for single-child nodes to reduce memory usage.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for trie insertion with various path patterns. Memory usage tests comparing trie vs HashMap storage. Path compression verification tests.

subtasks.title: Implement exact path matching algorithm
subtasks.description: Build the core matching logic for exact path routes without wildcards or parameters, establishing the foundation for the routing engine.
subtasks.details: Implement traverse method on Trie that walks nodes following exact path segments. Add method validation (GET, POST, etc.) at terminal nodes. Include case-sensitive path matching with proper HTTP method filtering. Return RouteMatch struct containing matched route info and extracted path segments.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for exact path matching with different HTTP methods. Edge case tests for empty paths, trailing slashes, and malformed URLs.

subtasks.title: Add wildcard (*) pattern matching support
subtasks.description: Extend the trie matching algorithm to support wildcard patterns that can match any path segment or multiple segments.
subtasks.details: Modify TrieNode to support wildcard markers ('*' for single segment, '**' for multiple segments). Update traversal algorithm to explore wildcard branches when exact matches fail. Implement backtracking for multiple wildcard possibilities. Add wildcard capture groups to RouteMatch for downstream processing.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for single and multi-segment wildcards. Priority tests ensuring exact matches take precedence over wildcards. Backtracking tests with complex wildcard patterns.

subtasks.title: Implement path parameter (:param) extraction
subtasks.description: Add support for named path parameters that capture URL segments and make them available to downstream handlers.
subtasks.details: Extend TrieNode to store parameter names for parameterized segments. Modify traversal to capture parameter values in HashMap<String, String>. Support parameter validation with regex patterns. Include parameter extraction in RouteMatch struct. Handle parameter conflicts with wildcard patterns through priority ordering.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for parameter extraction with various path patterns. Validation tests with regex constraints. Conflict resolution tests between parameters and wildcards.

subtasks.title: Create Redis-backed route cache with fallback to PostgreSQL
subtasks.description: Implement caching layer that loads route configurations from Redis for fast access with PostgreSQL fallback for cache misses.
subtasks.details: Create RouteCacheManager with Redis client for route storage. Implement cache loading that builds trie from Redis hash maps containing serialized route configurations. Add PostgreSQL fallback using sqlx for database queries. Include cache warming strategy and TTL management. Implement cache invalidation on route updates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Integration tests with Redis and PostgreSQL. Cache hit/miss scenario tests. Performance tests comparing cached vs database lookup times. Cache invalidation tests.

subtasks.title: Add route priority handling and configuration sync mechanism
subtasks.description: Implement priority-based route matching for overlapping patterns and synchronization system to update the matcher when routes change.
subtasks.details: Add priority field to RouteInfo and implement priority-based sorting in trie traversal. Create ConfigSyncManager that listens to Redis pub/sub for route updates. Implement atomic trie rebuilding on configuration changes. Add route conflict detection and resolution. Include metrics for route matching performance and cache hit rates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Priority resolution tests with overlapping routes. Configuration sync tests with Redis pub/sub. Atomic update tests ensuring no request failures during route reloading. Performance tests measuring sync overhead.

tasks.title: Develop HTTP proxy client with connection pooling
tasks.description: Create high-performance HTTP client for forwarding requests to upstream services with connection reuse and timeout handling
tasks.details: Implement ProxyClient using reqwest with custom connection pooling. Support HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and HTTPS protocols. Add configurable timeouts for connect, read, and write operations. Implement request/response streaming for large payloads. Include upstream health tracking and automatic retry logic with exponential backoff.
tasks.testStrategy: Load tests with 10k concurrent requests to verify connection pooling efficiency. Integration tests with mock upstream servers. Timeout handling tests with slow/unresponsive upstreams. Memory leak tests for connection pool management.

subtasks.title: Configure reqwest client with custom connection pooling settings
subtasks.description: Set up reqwest HTTP client with optimized connection pool configuration for high-performance request forwarding
subtasks.details: Create ProxyClient struct with reqwest::Client configured for optimal connection pooling. Set max_idle_per_host, pool_idle_timeout, and pool_max_idle_per_host parameters. Configure TCP keepalive settings and connection limits. Add client builder with custom resolver and DNS settings for improved performance.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for client configuration validation. Connection pool efficiency tests with concurrent requests. Memory usage tests to ensure proper connection cleanup.

subtasks.title: Implement HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 protocol support with TLS
subtasks.description: Add comprehensive HTTP protocol support including HTTP/1.1, HTTP/2, and secure HTTPS connections with proper TLS handling
subtasks.details: Configure reqwest client to support both HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 protocols. Implement TLS configuration with certificate validation and custom CA support. Add protocol negotiation logic and fallback mechanisms. Include SNI support for multi-domain upstream services.
subtasks.testStrategy: Protocol compatibility tests with HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 endpoints. TLS handshake tests with various certificate configurations. Security tests for certificate validation and protocol downgrade attacks.

subtasks.title: Add configurable timeout handling for connect, read, and write operations
subtasks.description: Implement comprehensive timeout configuration system for all aspects of HTTP client operations
subtasks.details: Add timeout configuration for connection establishment, request sending, and response receiving. Implement per-route timeout overrides and global defaults. Add timeout configuration in AppState and route-specific timeout handling. Include proper error handling and timeout-specific error types.
subtasks.testStrategy: Timeout behavior tests with slow upstream servers. Configuration validation tests for timeout values. Edge case tests with very short and very long timeouts.

subtasks.title: Implement request and response streaming for large payloads
subtasks.description: Add streaming support for handling large HTTP request and response bodies without loading entire payloads into memory
subtasks.details: Implement streaming request forwarding using reqwest's streaming capabilities. Add response body streaming to avoid memory buffering. Configure appropriate buffer sizes and streaming chunk handling. Include backpressure handling and stream error recovery.
subtasks.testStrategy: Large payload streaming tests with multi-gigabyte requests/responses. Memory usage tests to verify streaming efficiency. Stream interruption and recovery tests.

subtasks.title: Create upstream health tracking with retry logic and exponential backoff
subtasks.description: Implement health monitoring system for upstream services with intelligent retry mechanisms and failure handling
subtasks.details: Create HealthTracker component to monitor upstream service availability. Implement retry logic with exponential backoff and jitter. Add circuit breaker pattern integration and failure threshold configuration. Include health status caching and periodic health check mechanisms.
subtasks.testStrategy: Health tracking tests with simulated upstream failures. Retry logic tests with various failure scenarios. Circuit breaker integration tests and recovery timing validation.

tasks.title: Implement authentication middleware with JWT and API key validation
tasks.description: Build authentication system supporting JWT tokens and API key validation with Redis caching
tasks.details: Create AuthMiddleware that validates JWT tokens using jsonwebtoken crate, supporting RS256 and HS256 algorithms. Implement API key authentication with Redis cache lookup and database fallback. Add support for multiple JWT issuers and key rotation. Include user context extraction and workspace isolation. Support OAuth2 bearer tokens with introspection endpoint validation.
tasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for JWT validation with valid/invalid/expired tokens. API key authentication tests with cache hit/miss scenarios. Security tests against common JWT vulnerabilities (none algorithm, key confusion). Performance tests for auth middleware latency impact.

subtasks.title: Implement JWT validation using jsonwebtoken crate with RS256/HS256 support
subtasks.description: Create JWT validation functionality supporting both RS256 and HS256 algorithms using the jsonwebtoken crate for secure token verification
subtasks.details: Implement JWT token validation with jsonwebtoken crate supporting RS256 and HS256 algorithms. Create JwtValidator struct with methods for token parsing, signature verification, and claims extraction. Handle token expiration, issuer validation, and audience checks. Add support for both public key (RS256) and shared secret (HS256) verification. Include proper error handling for malformed, expired, or invalid tokens.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests with valid/invalid/expired JWT tokens. Test both RS256 and HS256 algorithms. Verify proper error handling for malformed tokens and signature mismatches.

subtasks.title: Create API key authentication with Redis caching and database fallback
subtasks.description: Build API key authentication system with Redis caching for performance and PostgreSQL database fallback for reliability
subtasks.details: Implement ApiKeyAuth struct that validates API keys through Redis cache lookup with PostgreSQL fallback. Create cache-aside pattern for API key storage with configurable TTL. Add API key hash validation using secure comparison to prevent timing attacks. Include workspace-scoped API key validation and permissions checking. Implement rate limiting per API key and proper error responses for invalid keys.
subtasks.testStrategy: Integration tests with Redis cache hit/miss scenarios. Database fallback tests when Redis is unavailable. Security tests against timing attacks and key enumeration.

subtasks.title: Add multi-issuer JWT support and key rotation handling
subtasks.description: Extend JWT validation to support multiple token issuers and implement key rotation mechanisms for enhanced security
subtasks.details: Extend JwtValidator to support multiple JWT issuers with different signing keys. Implement JWKS (JSON Web Key Set) endpoint integration for automatic key discovery and rotation. Add issuer-specific configuration management and key caching with refresh mechanisms. Support graceful key rollover during rotation periods and handle key ID (kid) header validation. Include configuration for trusted issuers and key refresh intervals.
subtasks.testStrategy: Tests with multiple issuers and different signing keys. Key rotation simulation tests. JWKS endpoint integration tests with mock key servers.

subtasks.title: Implement user context extraction and workspace isolation middleware
subtasks.description: Create middleware for extracting user context from authenticated requests and enforcing workspace-based access isolation
subtasks.details: Implement UserContext extraction from JWT claims and API key metadata. Create workspace isolation middleware that validates user access to specific workspace resources. Add request context enrichment with user ID, workspace ID, and permissions. Implement workspace-scoped resource access validation and proper authorization error responses. Include audit logging for authentication events and access attempts.
subtasks.testStrategy: Authorization tests verifying workspace isolation. User context extraction tests with various token types. Access control tests ensuring users cannot access other workspaces.

tasks.title: Build distributed rate limiting with token bucket algorithm
tasks.description: Implement rate limiting middleware using Redis for distributed state and token bucket algorithm for smooth rate control
tasks.details: Create RateLimiter middleware using Redis sorted sets or streams for distributed counting. Implement token bucket algorithm with configurable refill rates and burst capacity. Support per-client, per-route, and global rate limits. Add sliding window rate limiting as alternative algorithm. Include rate limit headers (X-RateLimit-*) and proper HTTP 429 responses with Retry-After.
tasks.testStrategy: Load tests verifying rate limits under concurrent access from multiple data plane instances. Accuracy tests measuring distributed rate limiting precision. Burst handling tests with token bucket behavior. Redis failover tests with local fallback.

subtasks.title: Implement token bucket algorithm with configurable refill rates
subtasks.description: Create a token bucket rate limiting algorithm that supports configurable token refill rates and burst capacity for smooth rate control
subtasks.details: Implement TokenBucket struct with fields for capacity, current_tokens, refill_rate, and last_refill_time. Create methods for consume_tokens() that checks availability and refills tokens based on elapsed time. Support configurable parameters like max_capacity, refill_rate_per_second, and burst_allowance. Handle edge cases like clock adjustments and ensure thread-safe operations.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for token consumption and refill logic with various time intervals. Burst capacity tests ensuring proper token accumulation limits. Concurrent access tests verifying thread safety of token bucket operations.

subtasks.title: Create Redis-based distributed state management using sorted sets
subtasks.description: Build Redis integration for distributed rate limiting state management across multiple data plane instances using sorted sets for efficient time-based operations
subtasks.details: Implement DistributedRateLimiter using Redis sorted sets (ZSET) to track request timestamps per client/route. Use Redis scripts (Lua) for atomic operations to check and update rate limit state. Implement sliding window cleanup using ZREMRANGEBYSCORE to remove expired entries. Add Redis connection pooling and fallback mechanisms for Redis unavailability.
subtasks.testStrategy: Redis integration tests verifying correct ZSET operations and cleanup. Distributed state consistency tests with multiple data plane instances. Redis failover tests ensuring graceful degradation to local-only rate limiting when Redis is unavailable.

subtasks.title: Add sliding window rate limiting as alternative algorithm
subtasks.description: Implement sliding window rate limiting algorithm as an alternative to token bucket for more precise rate control over time windows
subtasks.details: Create SlidingWindowRateLimiter that tracks request timestamps in Redis sorted sets with TTL. Implement fixed window and sliding window variants with configurable window sizes (1s, 1m, 1h). Add support for multiple concurrent windows (e.g., 100/minute and 1000/hour). Ensure efficient memory usage by automatically cleaning expired entries.
subtasks.testStrategy: Sliding window accuracy tests verifying precise rate limiting over various time windows. Memory usage tests ensuring proper cleanup of expired entries. Performance comparison tests between token bucket and sliding window algorithms.

subtasks.title: Implement per-client, per-route, and global rate limiting scopes
subtasks.description: Build rate limiting middleware that supports different scoping levels including per-client IP, per-route, and global rate limits with hierarchical enforcement
subtasks.details: Create RateLimiterMiddleware that extracts client identifiers (IP, API key, JWT subject) and applies rate limits at multiple scopes. Implement rate limit configuration in Route and Service models with inheritance rules. Support rate limit hierarchies where multiple limits can apply (e.g., 100/min per-client AND 1000/min per-route). Add rate limit key generation strategies for different identifier types.
subtasks.testStrategy: Multi-scope rate limiting tests verifying correct enforcement at different levels. Inheritance tests ensuring proper cascade of rate limits from global to route to client. Edge case tests for anonymous clients and missing identifiers.

subtasks.title: Add proper HTTP 429 responses with rate limit headers and Retry-After
subtasks.description: Implement standard HTTP rate limiting responses including proper status codes, rate limit headers, and retry timing information
subtasks.details: Create response formatting for HTTP 429 Too Many Requests with standard X-RateLimit-Limit, X-RateLimit-Remaining, X-RateLimit-Reset headers. Add Retry-After header calculation based on token bucket refill time or sliding window reset. Support custom error response formatting and rate limit exceeded messages. Include rate limit status in successful responses for client visibility.
subtasks.testStrategy: HTTP response format tests ensuring compliance with rate limiting standards. Header accuracy tests verifying correct Retry-After calculations. Client integration tests demonstrating proper rate limit handling and retry behavior.

tasks.title: Create control plane API with database operations
tasks.description: Implement complete REST API for route, service, and plugin management with PostgreSQL persistence and Redis sync
tasks.details: Build handlers for routes, services, plugins, and workspaces CRUD operations. Implement database layer with sqlx for prepared statements and connection pooling. Add input validation using validator crate and Zod-like schemas. Create Redis sync mechanism to publish configuration changes to data plane. Include workspace-based authorization and multi-tenancy support.
tasks.testStrategy: API integration tests for all CRUD endpoints with valid/invalid input validation. Database transaction tests ensuring data consistency. Redis pub/sub tests verifying configuration sync. Authorization tests ensuring workspace isolation.

subtasks.title: Implement database layer with SQLx for CRUD operations
subtasks.description: Build database access layer using SQLx with prepared statements and connection pooling for routes, services, plugins, and workspaces tables
subtasks.details: Create database connection module using SQLx with PostgreSQL driver. Implement CRUD operations for all entities (routes, services, plugins, workspaces) using prepared statements for security and performance. Set up connection pooling with configurable pool size. Add database migration support and error handling. Include transaction support for atomic operations across multiple tables.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for each CRUD operation with valid/invalid data. Connection pool tests under load. Transaction rollback tests for error scenarios. Database migration tests.

subtasks.title: Create REST API handlers with input validation and error handling
subtasks.description: Build Gin HTTP handlers for all CRUD endpoints with comprehensive input validation and structured error responses
subtasks.details: Implement REST handlers for routes, services, plugins, and workspaces using Gin framework. Add input validation using Go validator package with custom validation rules. Create standardized error response format with proper HTTP status codes. Implement request/response DTOs for API boundary. Add logging and metrics collection for all endpoints.
subtasks.testStrategy: API integration tests for all endpoints with valid/invalid payloads. Error handling tests for malformed requests. Validation tests for boundary conditions and edge cases.

subtasks.title: Add Redis pub/sub mechanism for configuration sync
subtasks.description: Implement Redis publisher to broadcast configuration changes to data plane instances for real-time sync
subtasks.details: Create Redis client with pub/sub capabilities for configuration synchronization. Publish events when routes, services, or plugins are created/updated/deleted. Design event payload format with change type and affected entities. Implement retry logic for failed publishes and Redis connection handling. Add configuration versioning for consistency checks.
subtasks.testStrategy: Pub/sub integration tests verifying event delivery. Redis failover tests with connection recovery. Configuration sync tests ensuring data plane receives updates. Event ordering tests for rapid successive changes.

subtasks.title: Implement workspace-based authorization and multi-tenancy validation
subtasks.description: Add workspace isolation and authorization middleware to ensure proper multi-tenant access control
subtasks.details: Create workspace authorization middleware that validates user access to workspace resources. Implement workspace extraction from JWT claims or API key metadata. Add database-level workspace filtering for all queries. Create workspace management endpoints for CRUD operations. Ensure all API operations are scoped to user's authorized workspaces with proper error responses for unauthorized access.
subtasks.testStrategy: Authorization tests ensuring workspace isolation between tenants. Access control tests with valid/invalid workspace IDs. Multi-tenant data isolation tests. Permission boundary tests for cross-workspace access attempts.

tasks.title: Implement load balancing and service health checking
tasks.description: Add support for multiple upstream instances with load balancing algorithms and active health monitoring
tasks.details: Extend Service model to support multiple endpoints. Implement LoadBalancer with round-robin, least-connections, and consistent hashing algorithms. Create HealthChecker that periodically probes upstream endpoints and marks unhealthy ones. Add circuit breaker pattern using failsafe crate to prevent cascading failures. Include service discovery integration hooks.
tasks.testStrategy: Load distribution tests verifying even request spread across upstreams. Health check tests simulating endpoint failures and recovery. Circuit breaker tests with failure threshold and recovery timing. Performance tests measuring load balancing overhead.

subtasks.title: Extend Service model to support multiple upstream endpoints
subtasks.description: Modify the Service data structure to store multiple upstream endpoints instead of single URL, including endpoint metadata like weight, status, and health state
subtasks.details: Update Service struct in models module to include Vec<Endpoint> field. Create Endpoint struct with fields: url, weight, status (active/inactive), last_health_check timestamp, and failure_count. Update database schema migration to support multiple endpoints per service. Modify service configuration loading from Redis to handle endpoint arrays.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for Service model serialization/deserialization with multiple endpoints. Database migration tests ensuring backward compatibility. Integration tests for service configuration loading from Redis with endpoint arrays.

subtasks.title: Implement round-robin load balancing algorithm
subtasks.description: Create round-robin load balancer that distributes requests evenly across healthy upstream endpoints in sequential order
subtasks.details: Implement LoadBalancer trait with round_robin algorithm. Create RoundRobinBalancer struct that maintains atomic counter for endpoint selection. Include logic to skip unhealthy endpoints and reset counter when reaching end of list. Add thread-safe state management using Arc<Mutex> or atomic operations for concurrent request handling.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests verifying even distribution across endpoints. Concurrency tests with multiple threads making simultaneous requests. Tests for skipping unhealthy endpoints and proper counter reset behavior.

subtasks.title: Add least-connections and consistent hashing algorithms
subtasks.description: Implement least-connections balancer for optimal load distribution and consistent hashing for session affinity
subtasks.details: Create LeastConnectionsBalancer that tracks active connections per endpoint and selects the one with minimum load. Implement ConsistentHashBalancer using ring hash algorithm with virtual nodes for even distribution. Add connection tracking middleware to update connection counts. Include hash key extraction from request headers, IP, or custom attributes.
subtasks.testStrategy: Load distribution tests measuring connection count accuracy. Consistent hashing tests verifying session affinity and minimal disruption when endpoints change. Performance benchmarks comparing algorithm overhead.

subtasks.title: Create active health checking with periodic endpoint probes
subtasks.description: Build health checker service that periodically probes upstream endpoints and updates their status based on response codes and timeouts
subtasks.details: Implement HealthChecker service with configurable probe intervals, timeouts, and failure thresholds. Create health check tasks using tokio spawn for concurrent probing. Support HTTP GET/HEAD requests with custom paths and expected status codes. Add exponential backoff for failed endpoints and immediate retry on recovery. Update endpoint status in shared state atomically.
subtasks.testStrategy: Health check tests with mock upstream servers simulating failures and recovery. Timing tests verifying probe intervals and timeout behavior. Integration tests ensuring endpoint status updates propagate to load balancers correctly.

subtasks.title: Implement circuit breaker pattern using failsafe crate
subtasks.description: Add circuit breaker protection to prevent cascading failures when upstream services become unreachable or slow
subtasks.details: Integrate failsafe crate for circuit breaker implementation with configurable failure threshold, timeout period, and recovery strategy. Wrap proxy requests with circuit breaker that monitors failure rates and response times. Include three states: closed (normal), open (failing fast), and half-open (testing recovery). Add metrics collection for circuit breaker state transitions.
subtasks.testStrategy: Circuit breaker tests simulating endpoint failures and verifying state transitions. Recovery tests ensuring proper half-open to closed transitions. Performance tests measuring failfast response times and overhead of circuit breaker logic.

subtasks.title: Add service discovery integration hooks and configuration management
subtasks.description: Create pluggable service discovery interface for dynamic endpoint registration and configuration updates from external systems
subtasks.details: Design ServiceDiscovery trait for pluggable backends (Consul, etcd, Kubernetes). Implement configuration watcher that updates Service endpoints when discovery backends change. Add endpoint registration/deregistration hooks for dynamic scaling. Include configuration validation and rollback mechanisms for invalid updates. Support multiple discovery backends per service.
subtasks.testStrategy: Integration tests with mock service discovery backends. Configuration update tests verifying endpoint changes propagate correctly. Rollback tests ensuring system stability during invalid configuration updates. Load tests measuring discovery integration overhead.

tasks.title: Build plugin system foundation with execution engine
tasks.description: Create extensible plugin architecture supporting transformation, validation, and custom logic execution
tasks.details: Design Plugin trait with request/response transformation methods. Implement PluginExecutor that runs plugins in priority order with error isolation. Create plugin registry for loading and configuring plugins at startup. Add built-in plugins for header transformation, request/response logging, and CORS. Support plugin configuration at global, service, and route levels.
tasks.testStrategy: Plugin execution tests with chain of transformations. Error isolation tests ensuring plugin failures don't crash requests. Priority ordering tests with multiple plugins. Plugin configuration tests at different scopes.

subtasks.title: Design and implement Plugin trait with request/response transformation methods
subtasks.description: Create the foundational Plugin trait that defines the interface for all plugins with methods for transforming HTTP requests and responses
subtasks.details: Define Plugin trait with methods like transform_request, transform_response, and get_name. Include error handling with custom PluginError type. Add plugin metadata fields for name, version, and description. Ensure async compatibility and define clear input/output types for request/response transformation.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests for trait implementation with mock plugins. Test request/response transformation with various HTTP methods and headers.

subtasks.title: Create PluginExecutor for priority-ordered execution with error isolation
subtasks.description: Implement the core execution engine that runs plugins in priority order while isolating errors to prevent system crashes
subtasks.details: Build PluginExecutor struct that maintains plugins sorted by priority. Implement execute_chain method that runs plugins sequentially with proper error isolation using Result types. Add timeout handling for plugin execution and circuit breaker pattern for failing plugins. Include execution context passing between plugins.
subtasks.testStrategy: Error isolation tests ensuring plugin failures don't crash requests. Priority ordering tests with multiple plugins. Timeout and circuit breaker tests.

subtasks.title: Implement plugin registry for loading and configuration at startup
subtasks.description: Create a plugin registry system that loads, validates, and configures plugins during application initialization
subtasks.details: Develop PluginRegistry struct that loads plugins from configuration and validates their implementations. Add plugin discovery mechanism and configuration validation. Implement plugin lifecycle management with proper initialization and cleanup. Support dynamic plugin configuration updates from Redis.
subtasks.testStrategy: Plugin loading tests with valid and invalid configurations. Registry initialization tests with missing plugins. Configuration update tests.

subtasks.title: Develop built-in plugins for header transformation, logging, and CORS
subtasks.description: Create essential built-in plugins that provide common functionality like header manipulation, request logging, and CORS handling
subtasks.details: Implement HeaderTransformPlugin for adding, removing, and modifying headers. Create RequestResponseLoggerPlugin with structured logging and configurable log levels. Build CorsPlugin with full CORS specification support including preflight requests. Ensure all plugins follow the Plugin trait interface.
subtasks.testStrategy: Individual plugin tests for header transformation, logging output verification, and CORS compliance testing with various origins and methods.

subtasks.title: Add plugin configuration support at global, service, and route levels
subtasks.description: Implement hierarchical plugin configuration system supporting global, service-scoped, and route-specific plugin settings
subtasks.details: Create PluginConfig struct with hierarchy support where route configs override service configs which override global configs. Implement configuration merging logic and validation. Add database schema updates for storing plugin configurations at different levels. Include Redis synchronization for configuration updates.
subtasks.testStrategy: Configuration hierarchy tests verifying proper override behavior. Plugin configuration tests at different scopes. Database and Redis sync tests for config updates.

tasks.title: Integrate observability with Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry tracing
tasks.description: Add comprehensive monitoring with metrics collection, distributed tracing, and structured logging
tasks.details: Implement Prometheus metrics for request count, latency histograms, error rates by route and status code. Add OpenTelemetry tracing with automatic span creation for requests, database queries, and Redis operations. Create structured logging with trace correlation IDs. Export traces to Jaeger via OTLP protocol. Include custom metrics for plugin execution time and upstream health.
tasks.testStrategy: Metrics accuracy tests comparing collected data with actual request patterns. Tracing tests verifying span creation and propagation. Performance tests measuring observability overhead impact on request latency. Integration tests with Prometheus and Jaeger.

subtasks.title: Implement Prometheus metrics collection for request count, latency histograms, and error rates
subtasks.description: Set up Prometheus metrics collection with request counters, response latency histograms, and error rate tracking by route and HTTP status code
subtasks.details: Create metrics module with Prometheus registry. Implement request_count counter with route and method labels, request_duration histogram with configurable buckets, and error_rate counter with status_code labels. Add metrics middleware to record all requests. Expose /metrics endpoint for Prometheus scraping. Include business metrics like active_connections and upstream_health gauges.
subtasks.testStrategy: Unit tests verifying metric collection accuracy. Load tests measuring metrics overhead impact on request latency. Integration tests with Prometheus server scraping. Metric label validation tests.

subtasks.title: Add OpenTelemetry tracing with span creation for requests, database queries, and Redis operations
subtasks.description: Integrate OpenTelemetry SDK with automatic span instrumentation for HTTP requests, database operations, and Redis calls
subtasks.details: Add opentelemetry and tracing crates. Configure tracer provider with OTLP exporter. Implement tracing middleware for HTTP requests creating root spans. Add database query tracing with sqlx instrumentation. Include Redis operation spans with command details. Create custom spans for plugin execution. Add span attributes for route, method, status_code, and error details.
subtasks.testStrategy: Tracing tests verifying span creation and hierarchy. Performance tests measuring tracing overhead. Span propagation tests across async boundaries. Integration tests with trace collectors.

subtasks.title: Create structured logging with trace correlation IDs
subtasks.description: Implement structured logging using tracing crate with JSON format and automatic trace correlation ID injection
subtasks.details: Configure tracing subscriber with JSON formatting. Add correlation_id field to all log entries extracted from active spans. Implement log levels configuration via environment variables. Add contextual logging for errors with stack traces. Include request/response logging with sanitized headers. Create log aggregation structure with fields: timestamp, level, message, correlation_id, span_id, and custom attributes.
